metadata.question: Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Fire products (FIRMS or MCD64A1 burned area, or active fire MCD14A1) - Best option: MODIS/006/MCD64A1 (burned area) or FIRMS active fire data - I'll use MODIS/006/MCD64A1 which has BurnDate band - Date: August 2008 vs February 2008 - Location: Thailand boundary 2. Masking strategy: - MCD64A1 BurnDate band: values 1-366 indicate day of year when burned, 0 = unburned - Need to filter for valid burn dates in each month - For August: day of year ~213-243 - For February: day of year ~32-60 (2008 is leap year, so Feb has 29 days) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If no fires detected (burned area = 0), that's a valid "B" answer - C1: If no images in collection for the period - C2: If images exist but all pixels masked/invalid - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - Compare total burned pixels/area between the two months ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const thailand = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Thailand')) .geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition for August 2008 const aug2008 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2008-08-01', '2008-08-32') .filterBounds(thailand); const aug2008Size = await aug2008.size().getInfo(); console.log(`August 2008 Images: ${aug2008Size}`); // 3. Data Acquisition for February 2008 const feb2008 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate('2008-02-01', '2008-03-01') .filterBounds(thailand); const feb2008Size = await feb2008.size().getInfo(); console.log(`February 2008 Images: ${feb2008Size}`); if (aug2008Size === 0 || feb2008Size === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both periods.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Process burned area for August 2008 // Day of year for August: 213-243 (Aug 1 = day 214 in leap year 2008) const augImage = aug2008.select('BurnDate').mosaic(); const augBurned = augImage.gte(214).and(augImage.lte(243)); const augStats = await augBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: thailand, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const augBurnedPixels = augStats.BurnDate_sum || 0; const augTotalPixels = augStats.BurnDate_count || 0; console.log(`August 2008 - Burned pixels: ${augBurnedPixels}, Total pixels: ${augTotalPixels}`); // 5. Process burned area for February 2008 // Day of year for February: 32-60 (Feb 1 = day 32, Feb 29 = day 60 in leap year) const febImage = feb2008.select('BurnDate').mosaic(); const febBurned = febImage.gte(32).and(febImage.lte(60)); const febStats = await febBurned.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: thailand, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const febBurnedPixels = febStats.BurnDate_sum || 0; const febTotalPixels = febStats.BurnDate_count || 0; console.log(`February 2008 - Burned pixels: ${febBurnedPixels}, Total pixels: ${febTotalPixels}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (augTotalPixels === 0 || febTotalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (augBurnedPixels === null || febBurnedPixels === null || isNaN(augBurnedPixels) || isNaN(febBurnedPixels)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Comparison: August ${augBurnedPixels} vs February ${febBurnedPixels}`); if (augBurnedPixels > febBurnedPixels) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
